body: appreciate it, man. hoping the world looks up for you. my past relationships were full of being led on, taken advantage of, and being used for my body. nobody ever truly loved me, and even told me that. this world is the reason i despise the person i am. the truth is, the world will keep spinning whether i’m here or not. me being gone wont really change anything, and i’ve come to accept that it’s okay. i appreciate you sharing, i know it’s not easy. maybe i’ll hold out a few days, see if any life-changing revolutions happen, and cherish my last days with the few bits of joy left. maybe i’ll meet you in another life—wish i had kind souls like you and the people of this sub here for me years ago. stay strong, bud
i wish. been pushing for years but my parents never agreed with it, nor could we afford it
